svg.title: Three evaluation cases for a Terraform plan review skill
svg.desc: Illustrative test inputs and expected behavior, not observed evaluation results. A plan with public exposure should produce evidence-based risk analysis. A request without a plan should ask for input. A syntax question should not invoke the plan-review workflow. Compare the same cases without and with the skill.
svg.text: Test more than the happy path
Illustrative cases and expectations, not measured results
Input: a plan adds public network exposure.
Expect: identify the resource and explain the risk.
Input: "Review my plan" with no plan attached.
Expect: ask for the plan; do not invent findings.
Expect: answer without launching a plan review.
Same inputs. Without skill / with skill.
Compare behavior and evidence, not identical wording.
